affinity.notes: Bone, armor, robes, and staff define the figure; the magical halo remains a secondary effect rather than body construction.

anatomy.notes: Crowned skeletal humanoid and staff gesture are clear.

archetype.notes: Sovereign artillery caster semantically communicates the necromancer command duty.

counterplay.notes: The raised staff and concentrating halo provide a clear casting windup and focal source for the impending attack.

finish.notes: Ornate magical detail remains organized around a readable silhouette.

framing.notes: Circular dais and halo frame the central figure effectively.

identity.notes: Skeletal lich king exactly identifies the mapped form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
